skills.title: Research capabilities

description.prefix: View and manage the research methods, analysis tools, and extensions available to this task.

install.placeholder: Describe the research capability you need, or provide a link to an existing tool or resource
install.hintConnected: AI4HEOR first prepares and checks a local candidate. It cannot run before review and admission are complete.

candidates.boundary: Candidates are local, instruction-only drafts. The desktop app rechecks the exact bytes before recording your decision; activation affects only this project and does not transfer scientific authority.
candidates.unavailable: The candidate or review chain could not be verified. No capability was changed.
candidates.noProject: Create or open an AI4HEOR project to review project capabilities.
candidates.empty: No capability candidate has been created in this project.

purpose.activate: The assistant prepared this project Skill candidate to define how similar tasks should be handled later. It is not a pharmacoeconomic analysis and cannot choose methods, evidence, parameters, or conclusions for the researcher. It becomes active only after you confirm it.
purpose.reject: You are deciding whether this Skill candidate should remain inactive. This is not a judgment on a study plan or analysis result.
purpose.revoke: You are stopping a previously activated project Skill. This decision does not rewrite research methods, evidence, parameters, or conclusions.

boundary.activate: Activation copies only these validated instruction files into the current project. It grants no network, command, secret, or outside-workspace permission.
boundary.reject: Rejection records your decision for these exact candidate bytes. The candidate remains inactive and available for audit.
boundary.revoke: Revocation removes the active project copy only when its bytes still match the activation record. Changed content is never deleted automatically.

rationalePlaceholder.activate: State what you checked and why this narrow capability is acceptable for this project.
rationalePlaceholder.reject: State why the candidate should remain inactive.
rationalePlaceholder.revoke: State why the previously active capability should no longer run in this project.

confirm.activate: I reviewed this capability's purpose, instructions, license note, limitations, and every acceptance check. I authorize this instruction-only Skill for the current project.
confirm.reject: I understand this candidate's purpose and limitations and want it to remain inactive.
confirm.revoke: I understand the effect of revocation and want to stop using the project Skill that matches the activation record.

preferences.boundary: AI4HEOR may suggest a preference only after the same working habit appears in at least two independent interactions. Nothing becomes a lasting rule until you review it. Preferences cannot change methods, evidence, parameters, conclusions, approvals, provider choice, or data routing.
preferences.loading: Checking preference proposals and accepted preferences…
preferences.unavailable: The proposal, preference store, or review chain could not be verified. Nothing was changed.
preferences.noProject: Create or open an AI4HEOR project to review local preferences.
preferences.empty: No repeated work preference has been proposed in this project.

boundary.accept: Check whether the repeated observations really describe how you want AI4HEOR to work. You may edit the wording before accepting it.
boundary.update: Edit only the working preference. It cannot contain confidential material or make a scientific decision for you.
boundary.enable: This restores the reviewed preference for future work in this project.
boundary.disable: The preference stays in the local record but will not be used while paused.
boundary.delete: This removes the preference from the active local store. The Human decision remains in the audit record.

rationalePlaceholder.accept: Explain why this repeated pattern should become a local work preference.
rationalePlaceholder.update: Explain why the wording needs to change.
rationalePlaceholder.enable: Explain why you want to use it again.
rationalePlaceholder.disable: Explain why it should be paused.
rationalePlaceholder.delete: Explain why it should be removed.

confirm.accept: I reviewed the observations and wording. This is a non-sensitive work preference, not a scientific decision.
confirm.update: I reviewed the revised wording and confirm that it remains a non-sensitive work preference.
confirm.enable: I want this reviewed work preference to be used again.
confirm.disable: I want this work preference paused without deleting its local record.
confirm.delete: I want this preference removed from the active local store.

assetAdmission.loading: Checking external adapters shipped with the app…
assetAdmission.unavailable: External tools could not be checked, so none were enabled.
assetAdmission.firstPartyTitle: 52 first-party AI4HEOR Skills are built in
assetAdmission.firstPartyBoundary: Only external adapters that passed license, security, methods, and package checks and actually ship with AI4HEOR appear here. Sources awaiting a rewrite or excluded from the product are not retained as user options.
assetAdmission.adapterBoundary: This adapter can run only inside its declared workspace, network, permission, and Human-in-the-loop boundary.
assetAdmission.noneAdmitted: No third-party tool currently ships with AI4HEOR. Required capabilities are first-party Skills; unfinished rewrites and excluded sources are not shown here.
assetAdmission.registryValid: The external-adapter registry is valid and {{count}} adapter is available.
assetAdmission.failClosed: The external-adapter registry failed validation. All external capabilities remain disabled.
